versions.changelog:
- Added explicit dependency on the Python requests library; installation via pip is now required.
- Clarified that token cache is shared across skills unless isolated; security note on global cache directory.
- Improved security warnings regarding config file reading and shared token cache.
- Updated documentation to specify dependency installation and adjusted security/config instructions accordingly.
- No functional code changes; documentation and metadata improvements only.

Ezviz Open Video skill initial release.

- Generate secure live and playback streaming links for Ezviz cameras on PC and mobile.
- Supports environment variable configuration for credentials (recommended for security).
- Optionally reads from OpenClaw config files if environment variables not set.
- Automatic access token management and caching with permissions and security warnings.
- Outputs ready-to-use Ezviz stream preview links for remote monitoring.
